Title: Subsidised fertiliser goes on sale at Sh3,500 a bag
Title (fr): L’engrais subventionné est vendu 3 500 shillings le sac
Narrative: On taking office, the President directed that 1.4 million bags of fertiliser be sold at Sh3,500 for a 50kg bag, down from up to Sh6,500. The pledge was Sh2,500.
Narrative (fr): À son entrée en fonction, le Président a ordonné que 1,4 million de sacs d’engrais soient vendus 3 500 shillings le sac de 50 kg, contre jusqu’à 6 500 auparavant. L’engagement était de 2 500.
Evidence title: Government releases Ksh. 3.5 Billion for fertiliser subsidy
Evidence finding: The subsidy sets a maximum price of Sh3,500 for a 50kg bag.

Title: Subsidised fertiliser drops to Sh2,500 a bag
Title (fr): L’engrais subventionné passe à 2 500 shillings le sac
Narrative: The second phase of the subsidy cut the price of a 50kg bag from Sh3,500 to Sh2,500, the price the President promised.
Narrative (fr): La deuxième phase de la subvention a fait passer le prix du sac de 50 kg de 3 500 à 2 500 shillings, le prix promis par le Président.
Evidence title: Ruto announces further reduction of fertiliser prices to Ksh.2,500
Evidence finding: The price of a 50kg bag falls from Sh3,500 to Sh2,500.

Claim: Set up a fund for small traders
Title: The Hustler Fund is launched
Narrative: The President launched the Hustler Fund in Nairobi, lending small traders between Sh500 and Sh50,000 through their phones. Whether it reaches Sh50 billion a year is still to be seen.
Narrative (fr): Le Président a lancé le Hustler Fund à Nairobi : il prête aux petits commerçants de 500 à 50 000 shillings par téléphone. Reste à voir s’il atteindra 50 milliards par an.
Evidence title: IN PICTURES: President Ruto Launches Hustler Fund
Evidence finding: The fund was launched at the Green Park Terminus on 30 November 2022.

Title: The Social Health Insurance Act is signed
Title (fr): La loi sur l’assurance maladie sociale est promulguée
Narrative: The President signed four health bills into law, among them the Social Health Insurance Act, which replaces the NHIF with three new funds. Cover for every household depends on how it is put in place.
Narrative (fr): Le Président a promulgué quatre lois sur la santé, dont la loi sur l’assurance maladie sociale, qui remplace le NHIF par trois nouveaux fonds. La couverture de chaque foyer dépend de sa mise en œuvre.
Evidence title: Ruto signs four Universal Health Care bills into law
Evidence finding: The Social Health Insurance Act abolishes the NHIF and creates three new funds.
